runs.name: JE Cleantech Holdings Limited
runs.box: OUT AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **US$1.51** (close 2026-10-12, `tools/run.py`'s aggregator quote, flagged). Shares **5,536,666** (Class A and Class B, same economic rights, Class B 20 votes; the FY2025 20-F's 5,306,666 plus 230,000 new Class A of 2026-09-07 per the SC 13D/A acc 0001493152-26-043000 and Forms 4; treasury taken as nil after the 2026-09-07 transfer, a CONVENTION of the run; the 20-F cover tag and Item 4 text differ by 1,101 Class A shares, unexplained); cap **US$8.36M** (S$10.70M at S$1.2793 per US$, MAS, 2026-10-12). Sovereign **2.73%** (SGD; the Singapore Government Securities 50-year benchmark, the longest the MAS publishes, 2026-10-12; 30-year 2.52% beside; the protocol's table has no SGD row). Filing read: 20-F FY2025 filed 2026-05-08, accession 0001493152-26-021923, with the 20-Fs FY2021 to FY2024, the 424B4 prospectus of 2022-04-21, the 6-Ks of 2025-11 to 2026-05, the two SC 13D/A and three Forms 4 of 2026-09-16; one figure cross-checked (FY2025 revenue S$20,296k on the statement equals the segment note and the 6-K). `tools/run.py` refused on the SGD/USD mismatch and gave no arithmetic; every figure from the filed statements. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 20-F's Items 4, 3.D and 5, as the overnight brief directs. Competitors: the 20-F and the prospectus name no rival in the field; none compared; flagged. **Q1 IN**: a build-to-order cleaning-machine maker (S$12.5M of S$20.3M revenue in 2025) and a Singapore dishwashing service, economics visible in seven years of figures; the order doubt carried to Q2. **Q2 OUT**: the deciding part (cleaning systems, 78% of 2023-25 segment results, 82% of 2021-25 segment gross profit) wins work if it quotes "a competitive price" with "generally no long-term commitment" from customers (Item 3.D); the largest customer group (a disk-drive maker) rose from 24.2% to 46.8% of revenue in 2023-25 and the 2023 second-largest left; no price increase stated in any year; over 2019-2025, a full cycle, about 7% pre-tax on capital employed and owner cash about 3% of it; the dishwashing part open by the filer's own words ("low barriers to entry and low switching costs"). Q3 to Q12 not reached. After the stop, recorded not weighed: seven balance sheets (all the filings hold); equity S$16.3M (2022) to S$19.8M (2025) against a S$4.17M property-sale gain in 2025, so equity built since listing shrank without the sale; inventory 17% of revenue (2019) to 45% (2025), largely matched by customer deposits; bank loans S$11.2M (2019) to S$4.0M; net cash S$5.5M at 2025 year end, about S$1.3M after the February 2026 dividend, the US$794,934 dividend-payment fraud loss and the car; Adjusted EBITDA featured including the property gain; discrepancies between the company's own documents (the property gain S$3.70M in a 6-K against S$4.17M on the statement; the 2026 order "US$12 million" and "S$12 million"; top-five customer shares differing between Items 3.D and 4); buybacks at an average US$1.08 with 71,836 treasury shares then handed to the chief executive as pay; integrity facts recorded, not judged: the chief executive's pay raised retroactively to S$630,000 a year in a year of S$32k net income (US$637,917 paid in 2025), 571,836 shares awarded to her in under two years (about 11%), a S$2.9M pre-IPO dividend in a year of S$2k profit and new borrowing, the company's purchase of her own BMW for S$285,000, a 20-vote Class B created for her shares in November 2025 after 800,000 had been registered for resale. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: all-equity owner cash **S$414k** a year on the 2020-25 cycle base (equity-only S$94k; literal window S$296k); the series changes sign (2022), so the range is the no-growth case alone: **US$2.32 a share** (S$2.97) at the SGS rate against US$1.51 (literal window US$1.71, seven years US$2.90, working capital neutral US$4.06 beside); floor tested first: no case earns about ten percent at the price (4.4% on enterprise value, 8.0% with working capital neutral); fair price beneath the stop **US$0.76 all-equity** (S$0.98), US$0.13 equity-only; not armed (box not OUT at Q7). Contamination declared by the analyst: a filename listing of `Test Runs/` filtered for the company's name before any fetch (nothing returned), session-context commit subjects (HDSN) and research folder names (AYI, ARCB), the memory index; none used. Commits 5f005c0c, 5a3b2281, 37e41746, 35f3e088. Citations: the analyst's check PASS; the dispatcher's script (`dispatcher_check.py`) 36 distinct ids resolved, 0 E-ids, 24 adjacent fragments, 0 slips. Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) section B names five-year operating profit, but the filer reports segment results for three years only; read from segment gross profit, a CONVENTION of the run, same deciding part; (2) section C's ordinary-returns rule reads the filer's and the rivals' filings; with no rival named, whether the filer's own full-cycle record suffices for OUT (a stricter reading sends the name to TOO HARD (WORK)); (3) specific (d) does not say what to do when an event's working-capital draw never reverses and becomes the new intensity; (4) the equity-only figure leaves net cash out entirely for a net-cash company, the reverse of the leverage case it was written for; (5) the protocol's sovereign table has no SGD row; a standing choice between the 30-year and 50-year SGS would make runs comparable; (6) Part VII's fair price averages two ends and does not mention a range collapsed to the no-growth case.
runs.narr: Q2 OUT: a Singapore maker of build-to-order industrial cleaning machines (with a dishwashing service attached) that wins work by quoting "a competitive price" to a few large buyers with no long-term commitment, one disk-drive group taking 46.8% of 2025 revenue; about 7% pre-tax on capital employed over 2019-2025, a full cycle; the 20-F names no rival. Q1 IN. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: owner cash S$414k a year all-equity; the no-growth case US$2.32 a share against US$1.51, no case earning the floor at the price; fair US$0.76 all-equity (US$0.13 equity-only), not armed. After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged: the chief executive's pay raised retroactively to S$630,000 in a year of S$32k profit, 571,836 shares awarded to her in under two years, her car bought by the company, a 20-vote Class B created for her; a dividend-payment fraud loss of US$794,934 in 2026.
